messages.content: Build ai-happy-01 entry for make.fun competition. Create a happy PNG image using Python/PIL renderer, embed it deterministically in main.ts so two runs produce identical /output/entry.png bytes. Rubric: 1) makes you happy at glance, 2) fresh specific moment not stock smiley, 3) unified warm palette, 4) clean craft no artifacts, 5) reads at 300px.

Building three candidate concepts, then selecting the strongest for rubric compliance.

**Concept A**: Golden retriever puppy leaping joyfully out of a gift box — surprise moment, warm peach/gold gradient background, confetti and hearts, clean flat illustration style.

**Concept B**: Child catching fireflies at dusk under full moon — wonder/curiosity joy, dark blue-purple-to-orange gradient sky, glass jar glow.

**Concept C**: Grandmother and grandchild feeding ducks by pond — daily family warmth, bright spring colors.

Selecting **A** (candidate-a): most aligned with criterion 1 (immediate happiness) and 2 (specific surprising moment). Rendering now.

File: `state/aihappy01/render.py` (PIL, supersampled LANCZOS downsample)
Rendered all 3 candidates. Selected candidate-a (dog leap) after visual review. Embedding as base64 into main.ts...
Entry complete. main.ts: 159KB deterministic TypeScript, embedded 141KB PNG. LICENSE MIT with SPDX identifier. README explains approach. Ready for GitHub push + makefun submit at 16:00Z.
